clause_b_zero_regression.instrument: sha256/uint64 view of raw IEEE-754 float64 bits; 0 ULP, not allclose
clause_b_zero_regression.why_threads_pinned: Multi-threaded BLAS picks its reduction order dynamically, so the last bit of a dot product can depend on how many threads were free. Clause (b) asserts 0 ULP, so the reduction order is fixed by construction rather than by luck. Measured side effect on this box with four legs running in parallel: a 400x400 np.linalg.inv took 3.5s unpinned and 0.0589s pinned, ~60x.
clause_b_zero_regression.declared_limit_inverse_arm: Every cheap quantity is swept at every J with the full 10-alpha set. The O(J^3) inverse arm is swept in full only to J = 400; above it the alpha set is [0.0, 1.5, 3.0] and the drop set is {0, J-1}. Same shape as leg 151's own declared cap (its inverse arm stopped at J = 1000 while its cheap arm reached J = 2000).
